name: Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd.
summary: Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd. engages in cooling systems, power systems, servo systems, electrical equipment sales, and electrical works contracting businesses in Japan and internationally. It offers cooling systems, which includes cooling fans and cooling fan units under the San Ace brand name; power systems products that comprises uninterruptible power supplies, inverters, engine generators, and power conditioners under the SANUPS brand name. The company provides servo motors and amplifiers, stepping motors and drivers, and motion controllers under the SANMOTION brand name.
